main.description: Report an account or record in a group, or a member's record in their public repo, opening or reopening it in the moderation queue. Uses service auth from the caller, who must be able to read the subject's space: a record's own, or the members space for an account or a public record. A report whose reasonType is appeal is an appeal, which only its subject may file: the account itself, or the record's author; one the queue already has is taken though its author is no longer in the group.

subject.description: An account DID or record URI.

cid.description: If set, a specific version of the record.

reasonType.description: For violation, cite the broken rule in rule. appeal asks the group to undo what it did to the subject.

rule.description: The group rule the subject breaks.

errors.name: InvalidSubject
errors.description: The subject isn't an account or record in this group, nor a member's public record.
